findings.code:
import pandas as pd
invoices = tables['invoices']
amounts_numeric = []
for idx, row in invoices.iterrows():
    if pd.notna(row['amount']):
        cleaned = str(row['amount']).replace('$', '').replace(',', '')
        amounts_numeric.append(float(cleaned))
total_amount = sum(amounts_numeric)
